```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = 'fig/om-examples-', fig.width = 6, tidy = TRUE, tidy.opts = list(blank = TRUE, width.cutoff = 95), message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r}
library(bdm)
library(lhm)
library(om)
```

```{r}
data(haknz)
dat <- bdmData(harvest = haknz$landings, index = cbind(haknz$survey, haknz$cpue), time = haknz$year, renormalise = FALSE)

lhdat           <- lhm(ainf = 30, iter = 100)
nmort(lhdat)    <- list(mu=0.18)
maturity(lhdat) <- c(0.0,0.01,0.02,0.06,0.14,0.28,0.50,0.72,0.86,0.94,0.98,0.99,1.00)
size(lhdat)     <- list(mu=list(Linf=106.5,k=0.229,t0=0.01))
mass(lhdat)     <- list(mu=list(a=1.88e-9,b=3.305))
sr(lhdat)       <- list(type='BH',mu=0.90)

om_object <- om()

om_object <- load_empirical_data(om_object, dat)
om_object <- load_lh_data(om_object, lhdat)
om_object <- load_B0(om_object, exp(10.5))
om_object <- load_selectivity(om_object, matrix(c(0,0,0,0,0,0,1)))

#pdyn(om_object)
#biomass(om_object)
#catchability(om_object)

om_object <- index(om_object, stochastic = FALSE)
dfr_det   <- reshape2::melt(om_object)
om_object <- index(om_object, stochastic = TRUE)
dfr       <- reshape2::melt(om_object)

boxplot(value ~ time, subset(dfr    ,index == 1), na.action = na.pass)
boxplot(value ~ time, subset(dfr_det,index==1), na.action= na.pass, add=TRUE, border=4)
points(om_object@empirical_data$index[,1], col=2, pch=19, type='b')

boxplot(value ~ time,subset(dfr    ,index==2),na.action=na.pass)
boxplot(value ~ time,subset(dfr_det,index==2),na.action=na.pass,add=TRUE,border=4)
points(om_object@empirical_data$index[,2], col=2, pch=19, type='b')
```
